_comment: Frozen test set metadata. Footage itself is NOT committed to git (local only) — this file tracks what exists locally so the test set composition is reproducible/inspectable from the repo alone. Frame counts cross-checked against LOG.md entries and recomputed directly via cv2.VideoCapture.

clips.notes: Empty as of 2026-08-22 — no chart/reference footage captured yet. This is the blocking item for the Week 1 gate (delta_e cannot be wired into `uw score`, and chart_refs.json patch regions cannot be measured, until a chart clip exists here).
1920x1080, 29.97 fps. Decodes in the expected landscape orientation.

Decodes as 1080x1920 (portrait) via cv2.VideoCapture. Unlike MURKYSHARK.MP4, not confirmed whether this is rotation metadata or an actually-portrait capture — flagged for the same reason: measure regions against the decoded array, not assumptions about player orientation.
1920x1080, 29.97 fps. Decodes in the expected landscape orientation. Referred to as the 'eel clip' in LOG.md.

Container reports 1920x1080, but cv2.VideoCapture decodes it as 1080x1920 (portrait) — rotation metadata is being applied at decode time, per LOG.md. Chart/color regions must be measured against the decoded frame array (H=1920, W=1080 as returned by numpy, i.e. cv2-reported WxH of 1080x1920), not against how the clip appears in a player that respects rotation metadata.

Generated artifact (gray-world `uw correct` output on MURKYSHARK.MP4), not source footage — listed for completeness but intentionally excluded from frame-count/duration bookkeeping above. Should not be treated as a frozen test set input; regenerate rather than hand-edit if it goes stale.
1920x1080, 29.97 fps. Decodes in the expected landscape orientation.

PLANNED, not yet captured. Week 3 controlled geometry clip (C1): rigid textured reef/rock/wreck, deliberate lateral or arc camera motion for real triangulation baseline, diffuse ambient light, NO dive-light sweep, minimal moving animals/vegetation, limited particulate, 20-40 s. Purpose-built for geometry diagnosis -- the existing clips were captured for restoration/temporal evaluation and cannot separate bad parallax from bad camera physics from bad matching from bad scale. Blocks the Week 3 gate.

PLANNED, not yet captured. Week 3 scale/calibration clip (C2): same scene family as week3_geometry, plus the colour chart at >=3 MEASURED camera-to-chart distances spanning near/mid/far and >=3 positions in the frame, a rigid known-length scale bar, and enough constraint on the target-plane pose to derive the distance to each reference corner individually (one scalar stand-off is NOT per-pixel range truth). Underwater checkerboard at 2-3 measured distances if practical -- that is what produces residual-vs-(image radius, range) evidence for the refraction test. Also record in-air GoPro intrinsic calibration at the same resolution/FOV/Protune settings. Blocks the Week 3 gate.

OPTIONAL, diagnostic only. Week 3 difficult clip (C3): low-texture sand or smooth panel, some fish/vegetation, normal swim speed, plus an artificial-light pass. Used ONLY to fire conditional challengers and to seed Week 6B. Never used to select the primary geometry method, and never a replacement for week3_geometry.

PLANNED, not yet captured, needed only at Week 6B. L1 ambient/diffuse control (light off); L2 controlled artificial light (rigidly mounted torch, ambient minimal, same scene points observed under different beam incidence AND at varying camera-to-scene distance -- distance variation is a hard identifiability precondition); L3 mixed ambient+artificial if practical. Calibration: measured camera-to-light rigid offset, chart at >=3 ranges x >=3 frame positions with light on, white/grey planar target sweep (~30-40 frames, varied range and angle, fiducials at corners), a few seconds of open water for the pure-water backscatter bound, and a repeat of the white-target sweep at start and end of dive to test beam-calibration transfer across battery state. L4 (the difficult real clip) is the EXISTING lights/LIGHTNIGHTDIVE.MP4 -- stress only, never the fitting set.

_roles.controlled_new: week3_geometry, week3_scale, week3_difficult, week6b_illumination -- purpose-built acquisitions that decide WHY methods differ. Selection happens here.
_roles.existing_frozen: chart, distance, lights, murky, swimthrough -- unchanged, and now additionally serve as the generalisation/realism check applied to the SELECTED method only. A method that wins on the controlled clips and collapses on murky or swimthrough has not won.
_roles.note: New data for diagnosis, existing data for realism. Adding the controlled acquisitions does not alter any existing clip, metric, or frozen Phase 2A/2B result.
